hookups.source: https://www.jackpinelodgeup.com/ ('56 sites all with water and electric - 48 sewer'; '30 & 50 amp to accommodate large RVs'), read 2026-10-22 + CampLife park record ('64 sites most with water and electric - 46 sewer'; Full Hook Up site 24494 '50/30/20-Amp Service', amenities Sewer, Water), read 2026-10-14

values.note: The operator's CampLife description (2026 rates) says 64 sites, most with water and electric, 46 with sewer, 11 pull-throughs; its own home page (headed '2025 Rates') still says 56 sites with 48 sewer. CampLife sells 46 full-hookup, 8 water/electric and 8 rustic sites (the rustic ones 'Tent and Van Only', 25 ft), plus 6 cabins.

sites.source: CampLife park record https://www.camplife.com/campground/campgroundDetails?cgId=233 ('64 sites most with water and electric - 46 sewer'; '11 pull-thru sites'; site list), read 2026-10-14 + https://www.jackpinelodgeup.com/ ('Pull thru sites'), read 2026-10-22

note: Campground behind the Jack Pine Lodge bar and grill on M-94, about 20 minutes north of Manistique in the Hiawatha National Forest, at the Haywire ORV trailhead; rustic sites are for vans and tents only, and there are cabins. Gas on site. Nightly and seasonal stays. --Claude
summary: Operator site + its CampLife record: 30/50-amp, water and sewer, 64 sites with 11 pull-throughs, seasonal $2,499 plus electric beside 62 sites sold nightly online. Confirmed hookups (now manual), added site count 64. Fees (W&E $47 / full $53 + $5 a stay, read on CampLife 2026-10-14) left as they are; the operator's '2026 rates starting at $49' for full hookup is consistent. Season not stated. Note cleaned of the hookups/facilities text the fields hold.
flags: Long-stay check (passes): a seasonal rate ($2,499 plus electric) is offered, but CampLife sells 62 of the 64 sites nightly online (46 full hookup, 8 water/electric, 8 rustic) and has no seasonal sites listed for online sale; not mostly seasonal.
Price gate: base $47 a night (water/electric) plus a $5 per-stay charge, under US$50.
